title: Molecular Structure and DNA Binding Mode of Unsymmetric Cyanine Dyes RiboGreen and OliGreen
authors: Nolan Blackford; Saileena Nepal; Huan He; Lianqing Zheng; Wei Yang; Robert Silvers
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR和MD模拟解析了花青染料与DNA的结合模式，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作及MD方法可迁移借鉴。
abstract: The binding of fluorescent dyes to nucleic acids and their fluorogenic properties are indispensable tools for nucleic acid detection, quantification, and imaging, yet the molecular structures of several widely used commercial dyes have remained unknown. Here, we de novo determined the molecular structures of RiboGreen and OliGreen and confirmed the previously proposed structure of PicoGreen using high-field NMR spectroscopy and ultra-high resolution mass spectrometry. All three dyes were identified as unsymmetric cyanine dyes, where benzazolium and 4-quinolinium moieties are linked by a monomethine bridge. Complete 1 H and 13 C resonance assignments enabled us to expand the existing chemical shift reference set for this important class of dyes. Photophysical characterization with standardized single- and double-stranded DNA and RNA targets indicated that all dyes performed similarly upon binding despite being marketed towards different nucleic acid types. NMR spectroscopy and long-timescale molecular dynamics simulations showed that RiboGreen interacts with double-stranded DNA predominantly by two binding modes, electrostatic interactions with the phosphodiester backbone and π-π stacking with accessible nucleobases of the DNA molecule. These results establish the molecular structures of three widely used commercial dyes and provide a structural and mechanistic framework for understanding the fluorogenic properties of this class of dyes. Highlights Determination of the molecular structures of nucleic acid dyes RiboGreen, OliGreen, and PicoGreen NMR spectroscopic characterization of all three dyes. NMR and MD data indicate binding to be dominated by electrostatic and π-π stacking interactions
abstract_zh: 荧光染料与核酸的结合及其荧光生成特性是核酸检测、定量和成像不可或缺的工具，然而几种广泛使用的商业染料的分子结构至今未知。在此，我们利用高场核磁共振波谱和超高分辨率质谱，从头确定了RiboGreen和OliGreen的分子结构，并确认了先前提出的PicoGreen结构。所有三种染料均被鉴定为不对称花青染料，其中苯并唑鎓和4-喹啉鎓部分通过单甲炔桥连接。完整的¹H和¹³C共振归属使我们能够扩展这类重要染料的现有化学位移参考集。使用标准化的单链和双链DNA及RNA靶标进行的光物理表征表明，尽管这些染料面向不同的核酸类型销售，但它们在结合时表现相似。核磁共振波谱和长时间尺度分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟显示，RiboGreen与双链DNA的相互作用主要通过两种结合模式：与磷酸二酯骨架的静电相互作用，以及与DNA分子可及核碱基的π-π堆积。这些结果确立了三种广泛使用的商业染料的分子结构，并为理解这类染料的荧光生成特性提供了结构和机制框架。亮点：确定了核酸染料RiboGreen、OliGreen和PicoGreen的分子结构；对三种染料进行了核磁共振波谱表征；核磁共振和分子动力学数据表明结合主要由静电和π-π堆积相互作用主导。
